units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 30b:5">Snh. 30ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 5:1">Lev. V, 1</cite>) <he>מקשינן ה׳ לראייה</he> the laws regulating the witnessing of the act must also apply to the evidence before court (that the two witnesses must be together).

senses.gloss: (v. אֲגָדָה) homiletics, popular lecture, opp. to הֲלָכָה legal interpretation.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 14a:6">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מה לך אצל ה׳</he> what hast thou to do with homiletics? <cite ref="Chagigah 14a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בעלי ה׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="A00006"><he>א׳</he></cite>) lecturers.
Ib. 3ᵃ במה היתה ה׳ וכ׳ what was the subject of to-day’s lecture?; a. fr.—13) Haggadah, the recitations at the home service on Passover nights, v. אֲגַדְתָּא.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:4:2">Y. Peah II, 17ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אין למדין מן הה׳</he> we must not derive laws from homiletical interpretations.
